tweets.text:
Jose Rodriguez Jr. of Lyford, Texas, faces 20 years in prison for possessing child sex abuse material.

He had photos depicting the sexual assaults of prepubescent children.

He began downloading the child sex abuse photos only six months after being released from a 13-year sentence for a prior child sexual assault conviction! 

🔎His prior conviction involved actually tying up the 9-year-old girl he planned to rape and an 8-year-old child he wanted to witness the rape. 

We’re proud of our special agents’ investigative work on this case and thankful to CBP and local law enforcement for their help. 

💻Search “HSI" on our website to see how ICE protects the nation from a lot more than just illegal aliens.
